prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Peroxide formation in cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil follows predictable pseudo-first-order kinetics at different storage temperatures, with rate constants ranging from 0.018 to 0.091 meq O₂/(kg·day) depending on conditions and activation energy of 48.3 kJ/mol indicating autoxidation of polyunsaturated fatty acids rather than photosensitised oxidation.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02918","field":"abstract","quote":"Rate constants increased from 0.018 meq O₂/(kg·day) at 25 °C to 0.091 meq O₂/(kg·day) at 60 °C. Activation energy calculated from the Arrhenius plot was 48.3 kJ/mol"}]},{"text":"Nitrogen flushing significantly reduces peroxide value compared to air headspace, but residual oxygen in the headspace critically influences oxidation rate, with a maximum residual oxygen threshold of 2% recommended for practical filling-line specifications in small-scale cold-press operations.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02921","field":"abstract","quote":"Nitrogen flushing significantly reduced PV at day 30 (3.2 vs. 9.7 meq O₂/kg, p < 0.001)"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-02921","field":"abstract","quote":"The paper proposes practical filling-line specifications for small-scale cold-press operations, including a maximum residual oxygen threshold of 2% in the headspace"}]},{"text":"Activated bleaching earth treatment can reduce initial peroxide value by 38–55% in cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil through adsorption of polar hydroperoxides, though this causes loss of tocopherols which serve as natural antioxidants.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02924","field":"abstract","quote":"ABE treatment at 2% reduced initial PV by 38–55% across oil types, confirming its known adsorption of polar hydroperoxides, but simultaneously caused a 12–29% loss of total tocopherols"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has conducted direct studies on peroxide formation kinetics in cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil [SYN-PUB-02918], investigated headspace oxygen effects and practical filling-line improvements for small-scale operations [SYN-PUB-02921], and assessed bleaching earth as a minimal-refining strategy to reduce oxidation markers [SYN-PUB-02924], directly addressing the company's core problem of identifying oxidation pathways and implementable process changes."}
